issue.title: Allow @path attachments in bead descriptions and sase bead create

task_type_fields.proposal: Extend the bead note attachment grammar (inline @<path> snapshots, @@ escapes, the content-addressed store, and the private sidecar upload) to bead descriptions. That covers sase bead create -d/-f and sase bead update -d. The description needs its own attachments manifest on the create and description-update wires, and rendering needs to match note chips and badges.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1ck deliberately left descriptions unchanged (plan phase note_cli: 'Leave close -r, snooze -r, and descriptions unchanged'). Descriptions use different core wires and field-update events than note_appended, so supporting them is a new design, not unfinished epic work.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1ck.10 (ga phase of epic sase-1ck) proposed this follow-up, and the epic plan listed it as one. Attachments currently work only in note text.
